# Cryogenic Feed Purification — Anatomy Explainer

A code-driven, anatomy-style motion explainer of cryogenic feed purification: how twin adsorbent vessels remove water and carbon dioxide upstream of a cryogenic cold box, how the spare vessel regenerates, and why downstream low-temperature equipment depends on that protection.

**Live:** https://mizcausevic-dev.github.io/cryogenic-feed-purification-explainer/
**Article:** `medium-article-Cursor.md` (full Medium draft, ready to paste)
**Hero image:** `public/assets/hero-Cursor.png` (1200 × 630, regenerated by `scripts/generate-hero-Cursor.py`)

## What this is

- 34 seconds, 30 fps, **1,020 frames indexed 0–1019**, each rendered in the browser as a pure function of its frame index. Scrub to any frame, jump by chapter, toggle labels, change speed, export any frame as PNG.
- Five chapters on fixed frame ranges: 0–149 reveal, 150–299 removal, 300–509 purified feed tracking, 510–749 conceptual regeneration with a qualitative inset, 750–1019 downstream protection and stable overview.
- Conceptual schematic throughout. No dimensions, materials, operating settings, efficiencies, certifications, vendor internals, or performance gains are asserted. No regeneration recipe. No total contaminant-removal guarantee. No operational instructions for hazardous equipment.
- Mass accounting is visible on screen at all times: feed in = purified out + retained on bed; retained contaminants leave with purge to vent during regeneration.

## Run locally

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # http://127.0.0.1:43123
npm run build    # type-check + production build into dist/
npm run preview  # preview the production build
```

## Deploy (GitHub Pages)

The production build is static and uses a relative base path, so it works as a GitHub Pages project site without configuration.

```bash
npm run build
# Publish the contents of dist/ to the gh-pages branch, or enable
# GitHub Pages > Deploy from a branch > gh-pages in repo settings.
```

This repository ships with `gh-pages` already populated from `dist/`. Pushing a new build to that branch updates the live site.

## Repurposing

The five-chapter frame engine (reveal, remove, track, regenerate, protect) re-skins to any twin-bed or guard-bed process: desiccant dryers, hydrogen purification, biogas upgrading. Swap scene geometry and captions in `src/main.ts`; keep the timing map, mass-accounting strip, and qualitative-inset labelling.

## Source and scope

Mechanism reference: Air Products, cryogenic air separation / on-site nitrogen generation (https://www.airproducts.com/supply-modes/gen-gas-on-site/onsite-nitrogen-generation/cryogenic-nitrogen-plant). The reference supports the underlying process architecture. Camera moves, palette, cutaways, and timing are original illustrative directions, not experimentally validated observations. Not a certified design or simulation result.
